name: task-agent
description: Read tasks from a YAML file (unified or legacy two-file format), implement one per run via an agent, and open a PR. Also ships `pr-reviewer` and `review-fixer` skills, plus thin `*-workflow` adapter skills (`task-agent-workflow`, `pr-reviewer-workflow`, `review-fixer-workflow`) that map their results to `$WORKFLOW_OUTPUT` for the `workflow` runner.
